# The Blueprint

> A course, with a free tier, in one trader's own intraday futures framework: setups, routines and risk management for index futures, with every claim held to a stated standard of evidence.

The Blueprint is a trading education site built around one trader's own intraday futures framework for MNQ. It is written for independent traders who want a complete framework — real setups, daily routines, risk management — rather than tips or signals. The framework is being built and tested in the open, and nothing here is presented as proven. The aim is to make the whole thing cheap and accessible, so another trader can learn it, test it, and build their own.

## Course

- [Module index](https://bptrade.co/): the course home page, with the full module index and where to start.
- [Glossary](https://bptrade.co/glossary.html): definitions of every trading term used in the course, with search.
- [Card deck](https://bptrade.co/modules/flashcards.html): 32 flip cards covering the course concepts, with study and quiz modes and filtering by section.
- [Dial In](https://bptrade.co/modules/dial-in.html): a five-question quiz that maps your market interests and habits to a trader profile and suggests where to start in the course.

## Journal

- [Trade journal](https://bptrade.co/journal.html): log trades against the course taxonomy — the pre-entry plan and its grade, the post-exit outcome — with export and import. Journal data stays on your machine.

## Site

- [Tools](https://bptrade.co/tools.html): NinjaTrader 8 indicators and add-ons, with install instructions and requirements.
- [Pricing](https://bptrade.co/pricing.html): the free tier and the Full Access tier, what each includes, and the current opening rate.
- [AI disclosure](https://bptrade.co/ai.html): how AI is used across the site, and what is verified by hand.

## Optional

- [Journal analysis](https://bptrade.co/journal-analysis.html): read-only review of the trade journal — expectancy by setup, trigger and grade, discipline cohorts, stop survival, exit efficiency, sequence effects and Gate 2 status.
- [Unlock Full Access](https://bptrade.co/unlock.html): enter the access code from your receipt. No account, no password.
- [Welcome module](https://bptrade.co/modules/00-welcome.html): what the course covers, how the modules are sequenced, and who it is for.
- [Toothbrush Therapy](https://bptrade.co/modules/13-toothbrush-therapy.html): the course's core philosophy page — building consistency by repeating the basic routines until they become automatic.
